data.name: AppTitle
data.comment: The name of the app; the title of the control window.

data.name: LensLabel
data.comment: Label beside the on/off switch.

data.name: LensOn
data.comment: Text on the lens switch while the lens is on.

data.name: LensOff
data.comment: Text on the lens switch while the lens is off.

data.name: LensSwitchName
data.comment: Name of the lens switch for screen readers.

data.name: ThemeLabel
data.comment: Label beside the theme list; also its name for screen readers.

data.name: BaseDark
data.comment: Group heading in the theme list.

data.name: BaseLight
data.comment: Group heading in the theme list.

data.name: BaseKeep
data.comment: Group heading in the theme list.

data.name: FillScreen
data.comment: Button: the lens covers the whole monitor it is mostly on; again to restore.

data.name: EditMode
data.comment: Button: the lens can be moved and resized.

data.name: EditModeHelp
data.value: In edit mode, drag the lens to move it and drag an edge to resize it. Arrow keys move, Shift with arrow keys resizes, Enter or Esc locks it again.
data.comment: Help text under the two buttons.

data.name: StatusLabel
data.comment: Name of the status line for screen readers.

data.name: StatusOff
data.comment: Status: the lens is off.

data.name: StatusLive
data.comment: Status: the lens shows the recoloured screen. {0} is the delay in milliseconds.

data.name: StatusLiveReduced
data.comment: Status: the lens runs slower than its standard budget.

data.name: StatusHolding
data.comment: Status: the lens shows the plain page colour.

data.name: StatusEditing
data.comment: Status while the lens is in edit mode. {0} is the live status text.

data.name: SlowStrongSharpen
data.value: Strong sharpen costs the most time. Nothing has been switched off.
data.comment: Shown with "Live, reduced speed".

data.name: SlowLocalContrast
data.value: Local contrast costs the most time. Nothing has been switched off.
data.comment: Shown with "Live, reduced speed".

data.name: SlowCpuRendering
data.value: The lens is drawn by the processor, because this computer has no usable graphics processor.
data.comment: Shown with "Live, reduced speed" on a machine without a GPU.

data.name: FrameRate
data.comment: Frame-rate read-out. {0} is a whole number.

data.name: FrameRateName
data.comment: Name of the frame-rate read-out for screen readers.

data.name: SoftwareRendering
data.value: No usable graphics processor was found. The lens is drawn by the processor and may be slower.
data.comment: Note shown when rendering runs on the CPU.

data.name: DevModeNote
data.value: Development mode: the lens is not kept on top and covers at most a quarter of the screen.
data.comment: Note shown when the app was started with --dev.

data.name: PatternNote
data.value: Test pattern: the lens shows a built-in picture, not the screen.
data.comment: Note shown when the app was started with --source pattern.

data.name: CaptureNote
data.value: Screenshots and screen sharing show the original screen, not the lens.
data.comment: A side effect users should know about.

data.name: ShortcutsHeading
data.comment: Heading above the list of shortcuts.

data.name: ShortcutGesture
data.comment: A shortcut as shown to the user. {0} is the letter key.

data.name: ShortcutNotSet
data.comment: Shown for a shortcut that Windows or another app already owns.

data.name: ShortcutRowName
data.comment: How a shortcut row is read out. {0} is the action, {1} the keys or "not set".

data.name: HandleText
data.comment: Text on the handle of the lens. {0} is the name of the theme.

data.name: StartFailed
data.comment: Message when the lens cannot be created at start-up. {0} is the reason reported by Windows.

data.name: CloseButton
data.comment: Button that closes a message window.

data.name: UnknownOption
data.value: ThemeLens does not know the option "{0}". It understands --dev and --source pattern.
data.comment: Message for a command-line option that is not understood.
